title: cynoglossum montanum var. parvifolium
intro:
Cynoglossum montanum var. parvifolium, commonly known as Chinese forked tongue or small-leaved hound's-tongue, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae) and is used in traditional Chinese medicine.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum montanum var. parvifolium include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help in relieving congestion and promoting the expulsion of mucus. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
